title: geraniospermum trifoliatum
intro: Geraniospermum trifoliatum, commonly known as the Chinese foxglove, is a plant species in the family Menispermaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Geraniospermum trifoliatum include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including geranioside, menispermine, and other alkaloids, exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, sedation, and antispasmodic effects.
